name: HYDRA-UMC-ORCHESTRATOR
notes: Established v0: real gRPC/Protobuf health-report schema, verified by actually compiling it with grpc_tools.protoc and round-tripping a real HealthReport message through serialize/parse - the shared service contract its 4 children build against. Plus a real, pure in-memory mission state machine (src/mission.rs): Mission (Pending->Dispatched->InProgress->Completed, Cancelled/Failed terminal), idempotent cancel() (cancelling an already-cancelled mission succeeds as a no-op, never errors), and recover_from_unavailable_node()/MissionRegistry::recover_node_unavailable() (requeues a Dispatched/InProgress mission to Pending when its node is reported unreachable/invalid). 42 tests. Exposed via the `mission-demo` CLI subcommand. Both real integrations are now wired: src/job_dispatcher.rs is a real HTTP client to HYDRA-UMC-JOB-DISPATCHER's own API (POST /jobs/submit, POST /dispatch); and src/server.rs's own POST /nodes/:node/recover is the real endpoint HYDRA-UMC-NODE-HEALING's watchdog.Reactor (OrchestratorReactor) calls into on every unhealthy-node transition, which drives recover_node_unavailable() above.
